note: Control points: city dots (Wikidata coordinates, CC0) plus three graticule crossings on the map (exact integer lon/lat). Dropped after the fit: Dresden (16 px residual, dot ambiguous) and Leipzig (12 px). Mean residual about 5 px; the map's own placement of towns limits accuracy to roughly 5 km. Output box is the scan frame; the polynomial is only constrained inside the control points (roughly lon 2-17, lat 46-55); far edges are extrapolated.
title: Central Europe about 1648 (Shepherd, Historical Atlas 1926 ed., plate 122-123)
